An en override whose gloss spells the word's toneless reading (北京 Beijing) fails the build unless it carries pronInGloss (why); such words get words[].pronInGloss either way. tools/zh_gloss_expect.json: the answers a B1 learner types per word; the build fails when one is not accepted.
